description: This file is an include script containing shell and Python code to configure license settings for GStreamer plugins within a build system, specifically setting plugin licenses based on the GSTREAMER_GPL variable and customizing build options with Meson.

methods.name: set_gstreamer_license
methods.description: A Python function that assigns license types ('GPL-2.0-or-later' or 'LGPL-2.1-or-later') to GStreamer plugin packages based on whether they are part of the GSTREAMER_GPL list, modifying the build environment variables.
